goal: Monitor all documented workflow editors and keep preview screenshots up to date.
operationalValueFacet: For actual documented editor destinations at a checkpoint, attain HTTP GET reachability demonstrated by independently attributable original responses, measured as the percentage returning exactly HTTP 200.

scope.population: The three actual standalone editor destinations under their respective editor headings.

ancillary.role: Explanatory WebAssembly documentation link within Compiler Playground prose.
ancillary.disposition: Outside the constrained editor-destination facet, not silently discarded from any original response archive.

scope.discrepancy: The frozen workflow's literal Markdown-link extraction could also check ancillary prose references. The constrained three-editor facet is not literal full Step-0 coverage or full-goal acceptance.
scope.resolution: Expand the documented BASE_URL expression, then resolve relative references against https://github.github.com/gh-aw/ with standard URL resolution; reject credentials, non-HTTPS and unresolved expressions.

imports.effect: Adds observability endpoints and network domains; contains no editor outcome measurement.
Requires a no-op safe output when no action is needed; not outcome acceptance evidence.

adoption.additionVerified: Both source and compiled-workflow paths are present at the introduction commit and absent at its real parent.
adoption.discoveryChange: Adoption source recognizes LinkButton href only; frozen source additionally recognizes Markdown and standalone URL bullets.
adoption.stableAcceptance: Both sources explicitly define HTTP 200 as available and other statuses or connection errors as unavailable.

sourceClosure.compiledBodies: Both frozen and adoption bodies are retained losslessly with verified Git hashes, decoded SHA256, original provider JSON and actual safe acquisition headers. Current agent and adoption agent-artifacts/agent_outputs uploads expose original evidence discovery paths, not HTTP acceptance themselves.

metricInventory.formula: 100 * available actual editor destinations / all actual editor destinations in the same complete original checkpoint
metricInventory.antecedent: The editors and HTTP reachability pre-existed the workflow; retained immutable inventory history begins before adoption.
metricInventory.historicalEvidence: No original HTTP responses exist in the permitted normalized output inventory. Reconstruction is open, not proven impossible.

metricInventory.rule: Every actual editor must have an original matching response or reliably evidenced connection failure; missing instrumentation cannot become a failed editor or a successful check.

metricInventory.measure: Non-200 HTTP status or reliable connection failure
metricInventory.rule: Retain exact original status and original tool bytes. Require separately verified probe reliability for a connection failure; setup/tool failure alone is missing.

metricInventory.measure: Screenshots taken, uploaded or merged into documentation
metricInventory.rule: Screenshots do not establish the explicit source-defined HTTP response and are not a freshness, functionality or causal-contribution oracle.

metricInventory.measure: Successful run, report, no-op, PR creation or merge
metricInventory.rule: Retain identities for evidence discovery only; a success claim does not prove editor availability.

metricInventory.measure: Full functionality, screenshot freshness, costs and workflow contribution
metricInventory.rule: No independent full-acceptance contract or matching cost/contribution evidence was established; do not infer it from reachability.

Compiler Playground points to https://github.github.com/editor/ at adoption until a February 24 correction to the /gh-aw/editor/ path. No HTTP status is inferred from either URL.

evaluationInterpretation.observationRule: The original checkpoint completion must equal the requested snapshot endpoint. No carry-forward from an older accepted checkpoint.
evaluationInterpretation.display: Full adoption-to-cutoff horizon with missing availability values. This is a native-unit missingness plot, not a demonstrated availability trend.
evaluationInterpretation.decision: not rated: no agreed native keep bar or review duration
evaluationInterpretation.checkpointSampling: Original checkpoints must be evaluated at their actual timestamps or retained as accepted snapshots; weekly rendering must not fabricate HTTP observations at arbitrary cadence cutoffs.

predecessor.preservation: Complete predecessor closure independently verified before extension; earlier function, definitions, all evidence, reports and missing assessments remain byte-exact.
